C-66.Name: Automatic update check on launch (desktop builds): at most once a day, a quiet notice with Update / Later / Skip this version, and a Settings switch
C-66.Summary: User request 2026-10-18: the download/Homebrew and Windows builds only check for updates on demand (Help › Check for Updates, Settings › General). Mark Text had an automatic check that the Tauri port dropped (store/autoUpdates.js is an empty shell). Add a launch-time check, rate-limited to once per 24 h, that shows a non-modal notice when a newer version exists, with «Skip this version» instead of a global «never show again»; the global off switch lives in Settings. The App Store build never checks (the store updates it).

Problem.Description: Users of the desktop build learn about releases only by checking manually; the 2.5.x releases shipped fixes nobody is told about. There is no persisted last-check time, no skipped-version memory and no notice UI.

Goals.R-1: On launch (after the main window is ready and the What's New gate has run), desktop builds call the existing mt_updater_check when the pref autoCheckUpdates is on (default on) and the last check was more than 24 h ago (persisted lastUpdateCheckAt). Offline or feed errors are silent (log marker only) and do not advance the skip state.
Goals.R-2: If a newer version exists and it is not the persisted skippedUpdateVersion, a non-modal notice appears in the window corner: «Mark X.Y.Z is available» with Update (runs the same signed install flow as file.check-update), Later (dismiss; next check after 24 h) and Skip this version (persist skippedUpdateVersion; a later version shows again).
Goals.R-3: If the What's New sheet opens in the same launch, the notice is deferred to the next launch (never two surfaces at once).
Goals.R-4: Settings › General › Updates gains «Check for updates automatically» (autoCheckUpdates); the manual «Check for Updates» row keeps working and ignores the skip state.
Goals.R-5: App Store build: the check, the notice and the setting are compiled out / hidden (M-048 build mode), like the existing in-app updater.
Goals.R-6: Strings in all ten locales (native copy). Tests: unit (24 h gate, skip/next-version logic, offline silence, What's New deferral, MAS gate), e2e chromium (notice with the three buttons against a mocked mt_updater_check; Skip persists; Later dismisses). grace lint 0; graph M-016/M-011 and verification updated.

Constraints.Item: No new network endpoint: the existing signed latest.json feed via tauri-plugin-updater.
No automatic download or install without the user's click.
Every GRACE-governed edit ships MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY; grace lint --assertions current = 0.

AffectedAreas.Item: src/renderer/src/store/autoUpdates.js (gate + state), src/renderer/src/pages/app.vue (launch hook after What's New), a notice component under src/renderer/src/components/
src/renderer/src/commands/index.js (shared install flow), static/locales/*.json, tests/renderer/**, tests/e2e/*.spec.ts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-6 done; npx vitest run green; e2e green; grace lint 0.
Live check (user): an older installed build shows the notice once a day; Skip hides that version; the App Store build never shows it.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Gate decision table pinned by unit tests; e2e invoke trace (mt_updater_check once per 24 h, never on MAS); notice screenshots in Paper and Ink.
